data.exact_reserve_text: An overall improvement of GBP 16.9 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. Improvements comprised of GBP 4.9 million on fire and other damage to property, GBP 3.8 million on marine, aviation and transport, GBP 2.7 million on energy, GBP 2.8 million on reinsurance acceptances and GBP 2.5 million on third party liability.

named_events.loss_description: The syndicate's largest natural catastrophe loss was incurred in respect of Hurricane Maria closely followed by Hurricane Irma and to a lesser extent Hurricane Harvey and Cyclone Debbie. It is estimated that these four combined will contribute US$18 million of net loss to the syndicate.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an overall favourable movement on prior years' claims reserves, with an improvement of GBP 16.9m in the year. Releases were concentrated across property-related lines (Fire and other damage to property: GBP 4.9m release), marine (GBP 3.8m), energy (GBP 2.7m), reinsurance acceptances (treated as Treaty: GBP 2.8m) and third party liability (Casualty: GBP 2.5m). The movement was attributed to favourable claims development rather than changes in reserve methodology.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development taken from Note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which explicitly states an overall improvement of GBP 16.9m; the note text is assumed to be gross (insurance liabilities) as presented in the movement note. Named catastrophe impacts are reported in USD in the narrative (US$18m combined net) and have been left unconverted; no gross PYD triangle reconciliation was performed for exact confirmation. Claims development table exists but has aggregated 'Before 2011' column which complicates direct diagonal calculations; triangle extraction therefore has lower confidence.
